title: Benefit-Usage Withholding from Northgate+ Business Refunds
content:
**Rule.** Under the Business closure schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, heavy use of membership benefits in the year before closure is withheld from the Business refund. The uses counted are the benefit uses recorded on the membership dated within the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date (dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by the cancellation date). One month's share of the fee is the fee divided by the paid term in months.

| Benefit uses counted | Taken from the Business refund |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | one month's share multiplied by 0.5 |
| 3 to fewer than 6 | one month's share multiplied by 0.25 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

The amount is taken before the Business refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical fee 120.00 on a 12-month term).** 6 uses take 5.00 and 5 uses take 2.50; 3 uses take 2.50 and 2 uses take nothing.
